citations.quote: The first is for the nominal interest rate to rise more than one-for-one with inflation, so that the real rate increases when inflation rises.
Interest-rate rules of the form in (12.44) and (12.45) are known as Taylor rules.
This is the process whereby a central bank’s interest rate gets transmitted through the economy and ultimately affects the rate of increase of prices

frontmatter_snapshot.summary: Modern monetary policy is parameterized via the Taylor rule i_t = r_n + phi_pi*(pi - pi*) + phi_y*(lnY - lnY_n) with the Taylor principle phi_pi > 1 ensuring real-rate stabilization; ZLB binds when the desired Taylor-rule rate is negative; Barro-Gordon dynamic inconsistency motivates rules vs discretion and conservative-central-banker solutions.
frontmatter_snapshot.title: Monetary Policy and Inflation
